dossier.scp_unleashed.020.title: Unseen Mold
dossier.scp_unleashed.020.caption: The north wall of SCP-020's cell, under work lights. The colony is present in this photograph.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The primary sample of SCP-020 is held in a single sealed vial inside a powered cold locker. Sealed glass is a complete barrier.

The cell is windowless and lit artificially. Staff entering it wear gas masks at all times. **A gas mask is sufficient protection.** No suit is required, and none is issued. Every surface in and around the cell is tested on a weekly schedule.

Staff leaving the cell are to %rcomplete Procedure 020-Delta%r before they rejoin other personnel. Surfaces that test positive are %rtreated under Procedure 020-Echo%r. Staff who report whispering are to be tested in the same way.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-020 is a murky green fluid. Poured onto a solid surface and exposed to air, it soaks in and is not seen again. The surface looks, feels and sounds exactly as it did before.

The colony is nonetheless alive. It spreads slowly to neighbouring surfaces, favours the dark, and will not spread in direct daylight. It grows in patches rather than as a solid sheet: where it grows thick, it stops advancing. A colonised surface gives off nothing that can be seen, heard or smelled. No one has ever watched it spread.

Subjects who breathe near a colony, or near an open sample, without a gas mask begin to perceive things that are not there. The effect deepens the longer they stay and fades over a few minutes once they leave. Reported in rough order of onset: whispering, close by and impossible to place; eyes opening across the field of vision, blinking and watching; and, at depth, other people appearing as the walking dead. The people around the subject have not changed. The subject cannot be persuaded otherwise.
No lasting harm has been recorded from SCP-020 itself. Affected staff have struck colleagues they no longer recognised, and fled from the people sent to help them.

page.title: Addendum 020-1: Field Note
text: Masked staff report nothing at all. Unmasked staff report that the eyes are always turned toward them, wherever on the wall they open.

A corner of the first cell was walled over to seal a colony in. The wall came down eleven months later, and %rthe whispering resumed within the hour%r. Interviews with affected staff are to be held in pairs.

page.title: Addendum 020-2: Provenance
text: SCP-020 was not recovered. It was handed to a reader of this file by an individual in Foundation dress, the same individual described in the files of other objects.
Asked why the sample was green, the individual said it was not, and that the reader was already looking at it wrong. %rMeaning unclear.%r See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp020.1: A sealed sample of SCP-020: a murky green fluid. While the seal holds it is completely inert.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp020.2: An open sample reaches anyone within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight. Solid blocks stop it, and a gas mask is sufficient protection: no suit is needed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp020.3: Use an open vial on a solid surface to pour it out. It soaks in without a trace and spreads slowly from there. Standing within %2$s blocks of a colony without a mask brings the effects on.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp020.4: The exposed hear whispers, see eyes that are not there, and may see other players as the walking dead. It does no harm. It builds while exposed and fades over a few minutes once away, about %3$s minutes at its worst.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp020.5: Only a swab read in an analyzer confirms it. Players and villagers can be affected. Pouring the sample into a petri dish keeps a live culture instead.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp020.query.posi: %s is under SCP-020: intensity %s of %s, clears in about %s s
commands.scp_unleashed.scp020.mold: %s SCP-020 patches in this dimension (limit %s, spread chance %s%%)
gamerule.scp020SpreadLimit.description: SCP-020 stops spreading in a dimension once this many patches exist there. 0 stops all spreading.
gamerule.scp020SpreadChance.description: Chance out of 100 that a random tick lets an SCP-020 patch spread to a nearby face.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp020.0: A sealed green sample is on its way to you. Keep it sealed.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp020.1: The contact finds the reader. Wait somewhere under open sky.
